extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers, panellists and introducers assessing NERC/UKRI grant proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and ethical guidance for reviewers and introducers assessing NERC (UKRI) funding proposals, covering which documents to use, confidentiality, policy considerations, and the prohibition on using generative AI in preparing assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the specific announcement of opportunity and reviewer guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: You should use the specific announcement of opportunity for the programme proposal that you are reviewing, alongside the reviewer guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Locate the relevant announcement of opportunity (programme-specific rules and criteria) and apply that together with the reviewer guidance when assessing proposals; do not rely only on generic guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Download and consult scheme-specific reviewer guidance and forms
rubrics_metrics.description: You can download reviewer guidance and forms at the following links: guidance for reviewers of discovery science fellowship proposals; guidance for reviewers of discovery science urgency grants; guidance for moderators of discovery science urgency grants; guidance for panel members of discovery science Exploring the frontiers 2022 proposals; guidance for assessors of discovery science pushing the frontiers; guidance for assessors of discovery science large grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the linked scheme-specific guidance and forms relevant to the call you are reviewing (they contain the detailed procedures and criteria for that scheme).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to applicant guidance and UKRI policies
rubrics_metrics.description: You can also view the guidance for applicants seeking NERC support and our policies on a range of issues from animals in research to research conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider applicant-facing guidance and UKRI policies (e.g., animal use, research conduct/ethics) when judging proposals for compliance, ethics, and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the funding finder to locate relevant funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: You can search for the relevant funding opportunities in the funding finder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unsure which specific programme or announcement applies, use the funding finder to identify the correct opportunity and its documentation before assessing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not use generative AI tools to develop assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers and panellists are not permitted to use generative AI tools to develop their assessment, including to correct language, spelling, grammar and formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using these tools can potentially compromise the confidentiality of the ideas that applicants have entrusted to UKRI to safeguard. For more detail see the UKRI policy on the use of generative AI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain confidentiality of research grant applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat application content as confidential and safeguard applicant ideas and data in accordance with UKRI/NERC confidentiality expectations and any related policies; see linked confidentiality guidance (last updated: 2 March 2026).
